title.narrative: Capacity development for innovation in Rwanda: strengthening innovation partnerships in six districts: Burera, Rutsiro, Gatsibo, Nyagatare, Bugesera, and Ruhango.

description.narrative: This proposed project is designed to strengthen agricultural innovation partnerships and processes that support climate-relevant and sustainable transformation of agriculture systems in Rwanda. It builds on, and further develops, the approaches and lessons learnt from the EU-supported CDAIS project 2015-2019, which strengthened capacities for agricultural innovation in three local partnerships and at policy level. The proposed Action will address outstanding challenges from the earlier project,
